title: P-256 sigma rho: top-limb distinguished test and anchor-test skip on the deferred-tests kernel

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1 (extended to the small-key y-window adder table), M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail, with the fold model for dy) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.732733 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. This is a conditional analytic bound, not an executed full-size attack. A=2^24, K=2^32, tau=0.4943092, residual Markov factor 400000, batches of 2^20 walks. Adders have Montgomery x in [2^192,2^231) and y within p/2 +- 2^-8 p, at most 2^40 fresh trials per adder with worst-case work charged. The deferred-tests field-step map is unchanged, but distinguished points now have canonical key < 2^196, theta=2^196/p, tested by one top-limb tst rather than extr and tst. Trail endpoints therefore change. The slot is (key >> 24) mod C, uniform on 2^172 inputs under M1 before reduction, and DP_MAX=2*ceil(S*theta)+2*K. The DP path skips the anchor comparison, and rounds 1..32 of every 64 compare no anchor, as described in proof.md; every cycle of length at most 64 is still caught within 128 persistent steps. The fix block preserves the canonical top limb through the y fix and re-runs the correct predicate. The comparison baseline PLAIN_FIXED is 605,593,356 instructions per 2^20-walk round; each arm also carries a 1,024-instruction allowance. Skip rounds (1 <= t mod 64 <= 32) test no anchor. The actual arm differences are PLAIN_ARM-SKIP_ARM=2*(B-1)+1=2097151 and ANCHOR_ARM-PLAIN_ARM=4*(B-1)+5=4194305 at B=2^20. Plain rounds pay 3 for dispatch; anchor rounds have t mod 64 == 0. Both seeds identify the three arm deltas at B=2^16; only skip deltas were paired at B=2^20, and plain/anchor charges there retain conservative parent prices plus instruction-form changes. C_COMMON is at most 576.604630, CORR at most 14.210693, total step charge at most 590.901468 instructions. The shorter fix path receives no correction credit: xy_fix stays charged 47 against the measured 45, C_MAX stays 123, exits charged 13. Measurements are organizer-image emulated instruction counts, not production success evidence: the preceding top-limb revision measured -(B-1) per round on its one-arm schedule; this revision's paired deltas against that path are -2*(B-1)+2, +3 and -1 for skip, plain and anchor rounds respectively; 2.4M compiled-tail cases agree with exact models. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. Peak memory below 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^81.961192 units, zero nonuniform advice. Conditional success lower bound exceeds 0.39000025; the full production collision and correction premises remain heuristics. Inherited reduced-order experiments retain the old DP predicate and support only their disclosed scope, not the new production predicate. probability.md replaces the selected-merge tail by a 1.3e-6 all-abandonment envelope and derives report overflow from distinct first exposures; the small-failure bucket is 2^-59, not the old unallocated 2^-20. These use the shared per-class M1 environment, common-phase continuation, worst-case rare debits and first-duplicate termination.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure, with checkpoint-only cycle detection and the small-key adder key rule at toy scale (adder_key_shift 2: adders redrawn until key < p>>2; shift 4 exceeded the runner's time limit; no y window), at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
